text:
Priya: Quick notice 10:00-14:00 UTC on 2024-05-15 is our pen-test window. Need owners for: logs export, RBAC snapshot, KMS mapping. Who's able to take packaging?

Marco: I can do packaging + create evidence tar. Will need presigned URL and size checks.

Eli: I'll export audit logs to ndjson and include kms.event_id + requestContext.user. We'll redact emails but attach an encrypted mapping file.

SRE-Bot: scheduler: slot reserved 2024-05-15T10:00Z -> 4h. presigned upload TTL 48h.

Marco: upload example:

Marco: ```
# upload from local
curl -X PUT "https://presigned.upload/xyz" -T ./redwood-evidence-20240515.tar.gz \n  -H "Content-Type: application/gzip"
```

Eli: RBAC snapshot commands:

Eli: ```
kubectl get roles,rolebindings,clusterroles,clusterrolebindings -A -o yaml > rbac-full-20240515.yaml
aws iam list-roles > iam-roles.json
```

Priya: For KMS: do NOT grant direct Decrypt to assessor accounts. We'll provide mapping.enc encrypted with KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/ef01-2345. Include instructions for decrypting mapping with our proxy if needed.

Marco: Will include kms-access-matrix.json showing which keys were used and which accounts are allowed proxy-decrypt.

Legal: Please ensure NDA is signed before sharing any presigned links. I have a checklist and will timestamp acceptance.

Priya: Good. Also, set a 1-hour post-test maintenance window to roll back any temporary RBAC swaps. Put rollback steps in PR and tag @oncall.

Eli: For log PII: I'll replace email addresses with placeholders and produce mapping.enc (AES-256) encrypted with KMS. Command: `openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -salt -in mapping.json -out mapping.enc` then `aws kms encrypt --key-id <key> --plaintext fileb://mapping.enc`.

SRE-Bot: evidence-uploader: presigned link generated -> https://presigned.upload/xyz (expires 48h)

Marco: I'll open PR ops/pt-packaging/ with checklist: rbac-full-20240515.yaml, audit-ndjson.ndjson, mapping.enc, evidence-manifest.json, presigned link. ETA: today EOD.

Priya: Schedule retest: propose two slots: 2024-05-29 10:00 UTC and 2024-06-05 10:00 UTC. We'll confirm after remediation.

Eli: Running a dry-run of the handoff script now: `./scripts/pt_handoff.sh --rbac rbac-full-20240515.yaml --upload https://presigned.upload/xyz`

Marco: Thx. Ping me when upload completes and I'll finish packaging.

Priya: Thanks everyone. Will post final checklist at 13:00 and close channel for the window. :bolt:
